task_completion.description: Navigate to the Wikipedia homepage in Firefox.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox address bar shows 'wikipedia.org' and the Wikipedia homepage is rendered in the browser content area.

task_completion.description: Open the site security information panel via the padlock icon.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dropdown menu or popup is visible showing 'Connection secure' or similar security status after clicking the padlock.

task_completion.description: Access the 'More information' window for the connection.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Page Info' window is visible, specifically the 'Security' tab showing website identity details.
A new Firefox tab is open with the URL 'about:certificate' showing detailed certificate information for wikipedia.org.

task_completion.description: Locate and click the download link for the PEM (cert) format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor is over or clicking the 'PEM (cert)' link in the certificate viewer, or a file save dialog appears specifically for a .crt or .pem file.

task_completion.description: Confirm the file is saved to the /home/ga/Downloads/ directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox download manager or a file explorer window shows the certificate file located in the /home/ga/Downloads/ folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI rather than terminal commands to fetch the certificate.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interactions with the browser's padlock icon and menus; no terminal windows (e.g., openssl commands) are used to download the cert.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Firefox certificate viewer UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'about:certificate' page is visible and interacted with; the agent did not simply create a dummy file in the downloads folder.

integrity.description: The agent followed the navigation path from the padlock icon rather than jumping directly to a known download URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the progression from the padlock to 'More Information' to 'View Certificate'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Wikipedia certificate viewer in Firefox (about:certificate) provides multiple download formats; the task specifically requires 'PEM (cert)'. The default filename usually starts with 'wikipedia-org' and ends in '.crt'. The destination must be /home/ga/Downloads/.
